label: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS)
description: A hormonal disorder causing enlarged ovaries with small cysts.

label: Endometriosis
description: A condition where tissue similar to the lining of the uterus grows outside it.

label: Irregular Cycles
description: Menstrual cycles that fall outside the typical 21-35 day range.

label: Thyroid Disorder
description: Conditions affecting the thyroid gland, which can impact menstrual cycles.

label: Other
description: Any other medical condition not listed above.
